QUOTE: The user taps the failed indicator (`post.failed.button`) in `app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`, then "Try Again" (`post.failed.retry`). ... `retryFailedPost` (`app/actions/remote/post.ts:228`) ... `retryFailedPost` is called from one place (the `Failed` component).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says retry happens only manually via the user choosing "Try Again" on the failed post, with no automatic retries, and names `retryFailedPost` as the function that handles it.
